bundle.title: Download result bundle
bundle.intro: Packs the research note's body, figures, fingerprints of the data it used, environment records, Workflow version and cited papers into one ZIP file, so another researcher or a reviewer can check it.
bundle.boundary: Data files themselves are not included. The bundle does not prove the result was run again; it holds the recorded fingerprints compared with the files as they are now.
bundle.loading: Checking what goes into the bundle

data.heading: {count} data files used
data.more: The other {count} are listed in the bundle.

bundle.environment: {count, plural, =0 {No environment record} one {# environment record} other {# environment records}}

workflow.none: The chat did not start from a Workflow.

bundle.references: {count, plural, =0 {No cited papers} one {# cited paper} other {# cited papers}}

download.done: Downloaded. The file's fingerprint matches the server's record.

error.load: Could not check what goes into the bundle. Try again.
error.changed: The note or its files changed after the check. Check the contents again, then download.
error.tooLarge: The note folder is too large to bundle. Move large files out of the note folder and try again.
error.integrity: The downloaded file differs from the server's record. Download it again.

public.title: Export public material
public.intro: Choose files to upload to Gemini Notebook yourself. GAID sends nothing to Google; you upload the downloaded files.
public.confirmEach: Confirm for each file that it may leave the institute. Only confirmed files are packed.
public.loading: Checking which files can be exported
public.noteDetail: A Markdown file, with the reference list of the cited papers appended.
public.licenceUnknown: Terms of use not checked. Check the paper's open-use terms yourself.
public.mayLeave: This file may leave the institute

skipped.heading: Cited papers that cannot be included
skipped.summary: {count, plural, one {# cited paper cannot be included} other {# cited papers cannot be included}}

public.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No files chosen} one {# file, {size}} other {# files, {size}}}

export.done: Downloaded. Add the files as sources in Gemini Notebook.

public.record: The names and fingerprints of exported files are kept in the project record.
public.none: Confirm at least one file to export.

error.load: Could not check the files to export. Try again.
error.changed: Files changed after the check. Check the list again, then download.
error.integrity: The downloaded file differs from the server's record. Download it again.

gap.no-chat: No chat is recorded as having written the note, so the data and environment are unknown.
gap.no-provenance: The chats that wrote the note have no recorded file use.
gap.data-limit: There were many data files; only the first part is in the fingerprint list.
gap.unhashed-data: Some data files were used without a recorded fingerprint.
gap.no-environment: The chats that wrote the note have no environment record.
gap.no-workflow: The chat did not start from a Workflow, so there is no Workflow version.
gap.workflow-removed: The Workflow was removed from the project, so its instructions are not included. The version is kept.
gap.unresolved-citations: Some citation keys are not in the library.
gap.missing-figure: Some figures the note links to do not exist.

readme.intro: Result bundle of a GAID research note. It gathers the note and its records so another researcher or a reviewer can check the evidence behind the result.

status.superseded: Status: replaced by a newer note

readme.headline: Result in one line: {headline}

part.note: Research note body (index.md) and the figures in the note folder
part.data: Fingerprints (sha256), size, time of use and comparison with the current file for {count} data files the note's chats read or created
part.environment: {count} environment records used in the analysis (Python and R packages, lockfile fingerprints)
part.references: References and CSL JSON of {count} cited papers

readme.notInLibrary: Citation key not in the library
readme.limitsText: This bundle does not prove the result was run again. It holds no data files, only the fingerprints recorded at the time of use compared with the files when the bundle was made.
readme.verify: Check that the bundle's files are unchanged with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.
